thread:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — Brightline's renewal is ready but procurement wants signature delegated to their procurement lead (procurement@brightline.eu) and invoices issued to Brightline EU entity. They've also asked for a vendor code on the invoice.
Ravi Chen: Ok, what's stopping us? Do we have delegated-signer auth on file?
Maya Patel: Not yet — legal flagged that the signer on the DocuSign envelope doesn't match our contract's signer email. Procurement sent a PO they need to attach.
Sofia Morales: We need the vendor code before we can finalize invoice entity change. Can they provide the code or should we map to our vendor list?
Maya Patel: They provided vendor code BL-EU-77 in the PO PDF. I'm uploading it to the customer record.
Oliver Grant: Legal note — delegated signature is OK if they provide a signed delegation letter or a company email from the delegated signer confirming authority. Otherwise we need exec sign-off per contract.
Maya Patel: Copy. I asked their AM to upload the delegation letter. If they can't, can we accept a countersigned docusign with our standard "delegation addendum"?
Oliver Grant: Yes, countersigned addendum works. Need to ensure the addendum references the correct company legal name and tax ID.
docu-sign-bot: Envelope 0x7f3b sent to procurement@brightline.eu — status: sent (view https://docusign.example/envelope/0x7f3b)
Lena Ortiz: Finance here — once we have the vendor code and PO attached we can reissue the invoice to the Brightline EU entity. Clarify payment terms: they requested Net60 but legal says contract is Net30.
Ravi Chen: Procurement is pushing Net60. Is there flexibility on our side? Any pricing change request?
Sofia Morales: We can offer a 30-day grace on first invoice for this customer but standard is Net30. If they insist Net60 we need approval from revenue ops.
Maya Patel: Action items: 1) Maya to collect delegation letter or countersigned addendum from Brightline (deadline EOD Tue). 2) Ravi to confirm PO upload and vendor code. 3) Sofia to prepare invoice reissue draft (hold Net30 by default). 4) Oliver to review addendum when uploaded.
Oliver Grant: I can review quickly once uploaded. If addendum missing tax ID we'll ask procurement to re-send.
Lena Ortiz: Ping me when PO + vendor code is in the portal and I'll queue invoice.
Ravi Chen: I've asked the AM to confirm vendor code + attach PO. AM replied they'll push it through procurement system and cc'd the procurement lead.
Maya Patel: AM provided a redacted delegation letter via email — I'll upload to the thread in the CRM and paste the DocuSign envelope link.
Maya Patel: Paste: ```Delegation letter: Signed by CFO, states procurement lead authorized to sign renewals up to $250k.```
Lena Ortiz: That should be sufficient for finance. I'll proceed to update billing entity once I see the PO with BL-EU-77.
Oliver Grant: I'll mark legal review as pending in the ticket; if addendum contents match CFO letter no further changes needed.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll update here when DocuSign completed. :thumbsup:
Lena Ortiz: FYI if Net60 gets approved later please note revenue recognition implications — loop revenueops.
Ravi Chen: Noted.
Maya Patel: docu-sign-bot just updated: Envelope 0x7f3b completed by procurement@brightline.eu — signature verified. 
Maya Patel: Uploading signed addendum to CRM now.
Oliver Grant: Reviewing the addendum: matches company legal name and tax ID, signer authority clear. Approved.
Lena Ortiz: Invoice reissued to Brightline EU (vendor code BL-EU-77) with Net30. Sending copy to procurement and AM.
Ravi Chen: Customer notified and AM confirmed acceptance. Closing loop.
Maya Patel: Closing thread — renewal executed, invoice issued, delegated signing accepted. Thanks team! :tada:
